members.description: Don't watch this pin for changes - nothing gets triggered

members.description: Triggers the instant the pin switches from off to on

members.description: Triggers on any change - whether the pin switches from off to on, or on to off

members.description: Triggers when the measured value leaves the safe/expected range you set - use to catch a value going too high or too low

members.description: Triggers when the measured value comes back into the range you set - use to catch when a value returns to normal

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_INPUT
members.description: Reads whether the pin is on or off - use for buttons, switches, and sensors that output a simple on/off signal

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_INPUT_PULLUP
members.description: Same as Input, but reads "on" by default when nothing is connected - use when your button/switch connects the pin to ground when pressed

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_INPUT_PULLDOWN
members.description: Same as Input, but reads "off" by default when nothing is connected - use when your button/switch connects the pin to power when pressed

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_OUTPUT_PUSH_PULL
members.description: Standard output - the pin can actively switch between on and off. Use this for most outputs like LEDs and relays

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_OUTPUT_OPEN_DRAIN
members.description: A weaker output that can only actively pull the signal to "off" - something else (an external resistor, or the Open-Drain-Pullup option) is needed to make it read "on". Mainly used when several devices need to share the same wire

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_OUTPUT_OPEN_DRAIN_PULLUP
members.description: Same as Open-Drain, but with a built-in helper enabled so the pin reads "on" by itself instead of needing an extra part

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_PWM
members.description: Rapidly switches the pin on and off to fake an in-between level - use to dim an LED or control a motor's speed

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_ADC
members.description: Measures the exact voltage on the pin instead of just on/off - use to read sensors that report a varying value, like a potentiometer or a temperature sensor

members.name: SYS_IO_MODE_DAC
members.description: Outputs an exact, steady voltage level instead of just on/off - the opposite of ADC
